The '''x41 maneuvering thruster''' was a model of [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering thruster]] manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]] was equipped with three x41 maneuvering thrusters supporting dual [[Tion Mil/Sci Industries/Legends|Tion Mil/Sci Industries]] [[Mil-StarIV engine]]s.<ref name="EGVV" />
